toolsPreview.name: jsonshelf_repair
toolsPreview.description: Repair malformed JSON. Returns valid JSON plus a diff of what was fixed.

toolsPreview.name: jsonshelf_validate
toolsPreview.description: Validate JSON against a schema. Returns structured errors with JSON Pointer paths and remedies.

toolsPreview.name: jsonshelf_example
toolsPreview.description: Generate a minimal valid example matching a JSON schema.

toolsPreview.name: jsonshelf_coerce
toolsPreview.description: Soft-cast values to match a schema (string "42" → 42 for integer fields, etc.).
